body.statement: At \(\gamma=0\), \(\mathsf B_0(v)=0\) for every \(v\in\Delta(\mathcal B)\), so \(v_0^\star\) minimizes the average stochastic radius over all blocks; if that radius is strictly convex and every control propensity is below one with positive design probability, every block receives positive weight. At every \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cc}}\), the concurrent vector \(u\) is optimal. For every target budget, \(\mathfrak L_\alpha^\star\le\mathfrak L_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\) because \(\mathcal C_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\subseteq\mathcal C_\alpha\). When \(\Gamma=\Gamma_{\mathrm{vac}}\), every full-record honest kernel admits an \(O^{\mathrm{cc}}\)-measurable randomized reduction with no larger worst-case expected length after integrating out the unrestricted bounded off-window outcomes under the known adaptive design; hence \(\mathfrak L_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\le\mathfrak L_\alpha^\star\) and therefore \(\mathfrak L_\alpha^\star=\mathfrak L_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\). Substituting \(v=u\) reduces the AIPW interval to the standard concurrent finite-population contrast under the same design.
body.justification: The endpoint reductions prevent the optimizer from laundering either unrestricted pooling or automatic rejection of valid borrowing.
body.gap: MarschnerSchou2024 Definitions 2.1--2.3 distinguish randomized cohorts, concurrent controls, nonconcurrent controls, and contemporaneous controls, but do not give a fixed-schedule minimax experiment or prove that unrestricted drift makes the full-record and concurrent-only all-kernel values equal.
body.consumer: The endpoints provide validation cases for the NCC implementation and ACTT sensitivity plots.

obligation.what_is_open: Two clauses are not certified: positivity of every zero-drift optimizer coordinate from the stated qualitative nondegeneracy condition, and the vacuous-drift reduction of every full-record honest kernel to a concurrent-record-measurable kernel under arbitrary history-adaptive randomization.
obligation.obstruction: Strict convexity alone does not force a simplex optimizer to be interior without a uniformly quantified lower bound on every block's quadratic coefficient. Separately, the conditional distribution of omitted off-window outcomes given the concurrent record can depend on the unknown fixed schedule, so integrating a full-record kernel against it can make the reduced kernel schedule dependent.
obligation.attempted: For the interior clause, a mass-transfer argument closes under a uniform coefficient lower bound, but that condition is not stated precisely in the target. For the endpoint equality, reference-schedule conditional averaging preserves neither the law nor uniform coverage for another schedule when omitted outcomes alter later assignment probabilities; a schedule-free garbling or dynamic symmetrization result is missing.
obligation.partial_result:
Several boundary assertions follow directly from the frozen core.  First, at \(\gamma=0\), every feasible control-mean vector is constant; since \(\sum_bd_b(v)=0\), Lemma \(\mathrm{lem:tv\text{-}support\text{-}dual}\) gives
\[
\mathsf B_0(v)=0.
\]
Thus \(v_0^\star\) minimizes only the stochastic radius over the full simplex.  Second, for \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cc}}\), the KKT equivalence proved in Proposition \(\mathrm{prop:strict\text{-}improvement\text{-}iff}\) says exactly that \(u\) is optimal.  Third, Definition \(\mathrm{def:concurrent\text{-}only\text{-}benchmark}\) gives \(\mathcal C_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\subseteq\mathcal C_\alpha\), and therefore
\[
\mathfrak L_\alpha^\star\le\mathfrak L_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}.
\]
Finally, substituting \(v=u\) in Definition \(\mathrm{def:borrowing\text{-}estimator}\) sets every off-window control coefficient to zero and leaves precisely the window-weighted treatment-minus-control AIPW contrast.

Two clauses remain uncertified.  Strict convexity by itself does not force a simplex minimizer to be interior; the positive-weight claim needs an explicitly quantified uniform lower bound on every block's quadratic coefficient, not merely pointwise positive design probability.  Also, the reverse inequality at \(\Gamma=\Gamma_{\mathrm{vac}}\) does not follow from the stated reduction.  Under history-adaptive randomization, the conditional law of the omitted off-window outcomes given \(O^{\mathrm{cc}}\) can depend on the unknown fixed schedule.  Averaging a full-record kernel against such a conditional law can therefore produce a schedule-dependent kernel, which is not an element of \(\mathcal C_\alpha^{\mathrm{cc}}\).
